ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher under NS-7; no account flag on the driver.
ruling.reasoning:
The cancellation was driver-side with a no-show claim, so the $6.61 fee can only stand if NS-1 is satisfied in all three elements [F4][F7][NS-0][NS-1]. The trace settles the two preliminary elements: the wait timeline has no GPS hole, and the arrival confirmation was a driver tap ("I'm Here" at 21:29:45, 41 m from pickup) with the closest approach 3 m — inside the 200 m radius [F1][F6][NS-1].

The decisive element (iii) fails on the system records. After the 21:29:45 tap the driver stayed within 200 m for only 1 min 45 s, and cumulative time within 200 m before cancellation was 2 min 55 s; the driver was stationary at 39 m for just 2 min 5 s before cancelling at 21:31:30 [F2][F3][F6][NS-1]. Both measures fall short of the "> 3 minutes" required by NS-1 (iii), and even the most generous anchor (platform-recorded arrival at 21:28:35) yields only 2 min 55 s [F5][NS-1]. The record carries no case-specific no-show threshold that would substitute a different figure, and no free-wait value applies [F2][F6][NS-1].

Because NS-1 (iii) is not fulfilled, the cancellation fee is not chargeable and must be refunded in full under NS-2 [F7][NS-2]. The driver's written claim of waiting "at least 5 minutes" is contradicted by the GPS and timeline records, which override statements, and by his own chat message "Cancelling, waited too long," so it cannot support the fee [F10][F12][F2][F6][NS-1].

No account flag is warranted. RD-6 requires an already-upheld route dispute within 90 days, and the driver's profile shows 0 upheld disputes of any kind; profile facts cannot decide a case and here they do not even trigger the added action [F17][RD-6]. NS-2's flag condition — an "I'm Here" tap made while GPS placed the driver outside the 200 m radius — is not met: the tap was at 41 m with a 3 m closest approach [F1][F6][NS-2]. This is a premature cancellation, not a fabricated arrival confirmation.

No external cause excuses the timing: no traffic incidents, no speed-band records, fair weather [F13][F14][F15].

rejected_claims.reason: The requested flag_account rests on RD-6's 'repeated' condition, but the driver's profile records 0 upheld disputes in 90 days (route: 0, no-show: 0) [F17], so no already-upheld dispute makes this case repeated [RD-6]; NS-2's flag condition (tap made while GPS showed the driver outside the 200 m radius) is also unmet, since the tap was at 41 m with a 3 m closest approach [F6][F1][NS-2].

Correct that no flag is available [F17][RD-6], but it does not follow that the fee stands: the flag question is separate from NS-1 (iii), which fails on the recorded 2 min 55 s cumulative and 1 min 45 s post-tap waits [F2][F6][NS-1].
